violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed pasteurized liquid egg stored under raw shell eggs in grill station area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged unit to have raw shell eggs on the bottom shelf.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked pork (131F) observed in 2 Dr stack warmer.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Pork taken to reheat.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the GRILL STATION being used TO FILL CONTAINERS WITH WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS discussed hand sink usage with employee and management. SODEXO CAFE O (Inspection Date: 08/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Other Chemical Proper Use
violations.observation: The operator is using a sanitizer, LACTIC ACID that is not chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound, and is not using the product in accordance with manufacturer's guidelines. Lactic acid sanitizer observed at 1.17.
violations.corrective_action: If a chemical sanitizer other than chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound is used it shall be applied in accordance with the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Please recalibrate sanitizer dispenser to ensure proper concentration. Ensure all food contact surfaces are sanitized in the high temperature dish machine.
